title: Transmuter's Stone (disambiguation)
html:
This is a disambiguation page, which links to ambiguously named articles. If you were brought here by a link in an article, consider editing it to direct towards the intended page instead.

Transmuter's Stones are stones created by wizards of the Transmutation School which are imbued with magical power that can provide their holder with boons such as resistance to damage or increased movement speed. The term may refer to the stones themselves or the abilities which create them.

  •  Transmuter's Stone (passive feature) - Passive feature of level 6 Transmutation wizards
  •  Transmuter's Stone - Container ability which lets level 6 Transmutation wizards select a stone to create
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Constitution which creates Transmuter's Stone (Constitution)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Darkvision which creates Transmuter's Stone (Darkvision)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Speed which creates Transmuter's Stone (Speed)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Acid Resistance which creates Transmuter's Stone (Acid)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Cold Resistance which creates Transmuter's Stone (Cold)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Fire Resistance which creates Transmuter's Stone (Fire)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Lightning Resistance which creates Transmuter's Stone (Lightning)
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Thunder Resistance which creates Transmuter's Stone (Thunder)
